what: LARGER/richer task (sizeB: n_super=48 n_members=8 n_prop=4 n_obs=14 hidden=64) test of whether a DIRECTED (supervised DFA) error on the MOVABLE plateau hidden converts train-fit into a held-out advantage over unsupervised sharpening -- the residual named by the np3 supervised-null finding.
headline: NEGATIVE 0/6: the larger task does NOT rescue supervised deep credit. Oracle heldout 0.869 (task learnable) but BOTH local movable-hidden rules floor at ~0.27 (unsup 0.278, sup 0.270), barely above the frozen reservoir 0.218 and far below oracle; supervised does not beat unsupervised (net -0.008, 3/6 up). The movable-hidden foothold does NOT scale to a richer task -- the local-vs-oracle deep-credit gap WIDENS.
